item.title: A small note
item.description: Writing does not always need a launch plan.
item.content:encoded:
Writing does not always need a launch plan.

Sometimes it only needs a place to go, a little attention, and a publish button that does not make a fuss.

This is the sample post included with Write Placid. Replace it with something of your own.
